agent_report.reasoning: The source confirms that the Python proposal contains many detections on the thick black connecting stroke and several CO2 333K assignments that are visibly orange-square or green-triangle pixels. Two proposed CO2 353K points are visibly blue pentagons and must be reassigned. The magenta 353K diamonds at the high-pressure end are clearly visible but were missed. Low-pressure markers obscured by thick curves cannot be added without sufficiently distinct native marker pixels.

series.label: CO2 303K
series.comment: The 14 retained red circles are supported, but several low-pressure red markers remain unresolved beneath the thick red curve.

series.label: CO2 313K
series.comment: Orange square trajectory is fully represented by the proposal.

series.label: CO2 323K
series.comment: Green triangle trajectory is represented; no definite correction is required here.

series.label: CO2 333K
series.comment: Several proposed points are visibly orange or green and were removed; two blue pentagons were recovered by reassignment, but additional blue pentagons are not represented with sufficient point-level certainty.

series.label: CO2 353K
series.comment: Two magenta assignments were corrected to blue, and seven clearly visible high-pressure magenta diamonds were added; low-pressure overlap remains incomplete.

series.label: CO2 373K
series.comment: The dense detections along the thick black stroke were removed. The retained plus markers are visible, but obscured low-pressure markers cannot be safely reconstructed.
